subject.title: [Bug]: openclaw gateway install adds a duplicate gui-domain LaunchAgent over an existing system LaunchDaemon (restart storm)

question: Should OpenClaw land the narrow same-label system LaunchDaemon guard now, or first define full user/system launchd lifecycle support?
rationale: The immediate duplicate-manager prevention is well scoped, but its fail-closed behavior changes the operator outcome for externally managed system daemons and requires an explicit compatibility decision.

options.title: Land the narrow guard
options.body: Prevent user LaunchAgent install, restart, and repair when a same-label system LaunchDaemon owns the gateway, while leaving full lifecycle support to the related issues.

options.title: Design full lifecycle support first
options.body: Pause this guard until install, status, restart, stop, uninstall, Doctor, and privilege handling share one approved system/user launchd contract.

recommendation.title: Land the narrow guard
recommendation.body: Prevent user LaunchAgent install, restart, and repair when a same-label system LaunchDaemon owns the gateway, while leaving full lifecycle support to the related issues.

likelyOwner.reason: The open candidate implementation directly owns the immediate technical decision surface, pending maintainer sponsorship.
